scoring_justification: Comparing reported gap and Tc to paper gold with tolerances; full recomputation of DFT/Eliashberg pipeline is infeasible in verifier, so we verify the final computed values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gap boundaries and Tc from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: sigma range (1.4,2.2) meV, pi range (8.0,9.3) meV; Tc = 230.98 K from linearized eigenvalue solution.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's explicit numerical statements and used as gold target.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values; they serve as the reproduction target and are embedded inline for the verifier.

outputs.description: Minimum and maximum superconducting gap on the σ and π Fermi surface sheets of MgB2 at 10 K (meV).
Critical temperature of YH6 at 300 GPa (K).

output_contract.notes: Checker compares each reported value to the paper's reference values within a hidden tolerance; values are exact_match because they are physical quantities with no directional 'better' (closeness indicates correct reproduction).
